# Policy reference

The policy decides what agents may do on each kind of environment, what the PreToolUse guard
counts as a change and what counts as a secret. Behaviour: [SPEC §7](../SPEC.md#spec-policy);
design: [0013](../design/0013-policy-as-data.md); a worked example:
[Full access on a trusted local machine](../how-to/trusted-machine.md).

## Layers

A later layer wins: the built-in **preset** named by the global layer → `[permission_defaults]`
and `guard_mode` from `config.toml` (legacy, only when set) → the **global** file
(`policy.json` in the data directory, setting `policy_file`) → the **project** layer → the
**environment** layer (both stored in the database, edited in Settings → Policy). The
environment's own level and per-capability overrides on Stands & access win over every layer.

Objects merge key by key; scalars and lists replace. A list key may also be written `key+` (add
items; a pattern with an existing `id` replaces it) or `key-` (remove items by value or `id`);
`key` is applied first, then `key+`, then `key-`. `$schema` and `description` are ignored;
`preset` is read from the global layer only.

The global file is read on start (a broken file stops `relaybay serve` with the path and the
problem) and again whenever it changes; a file that breaks later is logged, shown on the Policy
page, and the last valid version stays in effect. A broken project or environment layer is
logged and ignored.

Custom regular expressions (`guard.patterns[].command` / `change`, `secrets.allow`): at most 200
characters, no back-references, no quantified group holding a quantifier (`(a+)+`) or an
alternation (`(a|aa)*`), at most two unbounded quantifiers (`*`, `+`, `{n,}`), and fast on long
hostile input when the layer is loaded. They run case-insensitively with a hard time limit on at
most 8 KB of text; a call that times out fails closed (a guard pattern counts as matched, an
allow pattern does not allow) and is logged at most once a minute per pattern.

JSON Schema: [`policy.schema.json`](policy.schema.json) (the same file as
`src/relaybay/policy/schema.json`).

## Keys

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | string | Editor hint; ignored. |
| `description` | string (at most 500 characters) | A note for people; ignored. |
| `preset` | one of `default`, `strict`, `trusted` | Built-in starting point under every other layer. Global layer only. |
| `levels` | object | Agents' permission level per environment kind, used where an environment sets none itself. |
| `levels.local` | object | default: the level of the kind; a capability key: the level for that capability. |
| `levels.local.default` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | Level of the kind. |
| `levels.local.sign_in` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | Signing in and remembering the login. |
| `levels.local.ssh` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | ssh, scp, rsync, sftp. |
| `levels.local.kubectl` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | kubectl. |
| `levels.local.db` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | Database clients. |
| `levels.local.deploy` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | git push, helm, terraform, GitOps. |
| `levels.test` | object | default: the level of the kind; a capability key: the level for that capability. |
| `levels.test.default` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | Level of the kind. |
| `levels.test.sign_in` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | Signing in and remembering the login. |
| `levels.test.ssh` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | ssh, scp, rsync, sftp. |
| `levels.test.kubectl` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | kubectl. |
| `levels.test.db` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | Database clients. |
| `levels.test.deploy` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | git push, helm, terraform, GitOps. |
| `levels.live` | object | default: the level of the kind; a capability key: the level for that capability. |
| `levels.live.default` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | Level of the kind. |
| `levels.live.sign_in` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | Signing in and remembering the login. |
| `levels.live.ssh` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | ssh, scp, rsync, sftp. |
| `levels.live.kubectl` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | kubectl. |
| `levels.live.db` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | Database clients. |
| `levels.live.deploy` | one of `none`, `read`, `ask`, `full` | git push, helm, terraform, GitOps. |
| `guard` | object | The PreToolUse guard. |
| `guard.mode` | one of `off`, `log`, `warn`, `block` | off: no checks; log: live journal only, no messages; warn: a warning to the agent; block: deny (ask stays ask in every mode but log). |
| `guard.disable` | list of one of `kubectl-change`, `helm-change`, `ssh-remote-change`, `scp-to-host`, `sftp-session`, `sql-change`, `git-push`, `terraform-change`, `mcp-tool-name`, at most 50 | Built-in mutating rules to switch off, by id (replaces the list). |
| `guard.disable+` | list of one of `kubectl-change`, `helm-change`, `ssh-remote-change`, `scp-to-host`, `sftp-session`, `sql-change`, `git-push`, `terraform-change`, `mcp-tool-name`, at most 50 | Rule ids to add to the inherited list. |
| `guard.disable-` | list of one of `kubectl-change`, `helm-change`, `ssh-remote-change`, `scp-to-host`, `sftp-session`, `sql-change`, `git-push`, `terraform-change`, `mcp-tool-name`, at most 50 | Rule ids to remove from the inherited list. |
| `guard.patterns` | list of object, at most 50 | Custom mutating patterns (replaces the list). |
| `guard.patterns+` | list of object, at most 50 | Patterns to add; one with an inherited id replaces it. |
| `guard.patterns-` | list of string, at most 50 | Ids of inherited patterns to remove. |
| `approvals` | object | Which agent actions need the owner's approval on the board (one approval allows one matching call). Independent of the guard's mode. |
| `approvals.commit` | boolean | git commit needs an approval naming its branch (default false). |
| `approvals.push` | boolean | git push needs an approval naming its branch (default true). |
| `approvals.merge` | boolean | gh pr merge needs an approval naming the pull request (default true). |
| `approvals.test` | boolean | A change on a test stand (deploy, SQL, kubectl, ssh with a write) needs an approval (default true). |
| `approvals.live` | boolean | A change on a live stand always needs an approval: only true is accepted, a policy cannot drop it. |
| `approvals.desktop` | boolean | Check desktop sessions too, not only the program's runs (default false). |
| `approvals.disable` | list of one of `git-push`, `gh-pr-merge`, `git-commit`, at most 10 | Built-in action patterns to switch off, by id (replaces the list). |
| `approvals.disable+` | list of one of `git-push`, `gh-pr-merge`, `git-commit`, at most 10 | Pattern ids to add to the inherited list. |
| `approvals.disable-` | list of one of `git-push`, `gh-pr-merge`, `git-commit`, at most 10 | Pattern ids to remove from the inherited list. |
| `approvals.ignore` | list of string (at most 200 characters), at most 50 | Regular expressions: a command segment that matches one is never an action that needs an approval (replaces the list). |
| `approvals.ignore+` | list of string (at most 200 characters), at most 50 | Ignore patterns to add. |
| `approvals.ignore-` | list of string (at most 200 characters), at most 50 | Ignore patterns to remove. |
| `secrets` | object | What counts as a secret in environment fields, access entries and proposals. |
| `secrets.disable` | list of one of `private-key`, `github-token`, `github-pat`, `gitlab-token`, `openai-key`, `aws-access-key`, `slack-token`, `jwt`, `url-credentials`, `password-flag`, `curl-user`, `auth-header`, `token-header`, `sshpass`, `mysql-password`, `docker-login-password`, `redis-password`, `secret-assignment`, `secret-field-name`, `user-password`, at most 50 | Built-in secret detectors to switch off, by id (replaces the list). The journal still masks them. |
| `secrets.disable+` | list of one of `private-key`, `github-token`, `github-pat`, `gitlab-token`, `openai-key`, `aws-access-key`, `slack-token`, `jwt`, `url-credentials`, `password-flag`, `curl-user`, `auth-header`, `token-header`, `sshpass`, `mysql-password`, `docker-login-password`, `redis-password`, `secret-assignment`, `secret-field-name`, `user-password`, at most 50 | Detector ids to add to the inherited list. |
| `secrets.disable-` | list of one of `private-key`, `github-token`, `github-pat`, `gitlab-token`, `openai-key`, `aws-access-key`, `slack-token`, `jwt`, `url-credentials`, `password-flag`, `curl-user`, `auth-header`, `token-header`, `sshpass`, `mysql-password`, `docker-login-password`, `redis-password`, `secret-assignment`, `secret-field-name`, `user-password`, at most 50 | Detector ids to remove from the inherited list. |
| `secrets.allow` | list of string (at most 200 characters), at most 50 | Regular expressions: a value (or a detected secret) that matches one whole is accepted (replaces the list). |
| `secrets.allow+` | list of string (at most 200 characters), at most 50 | Allow patterns to add. |
| `secrets.allow-` | list of string (at most 200 characters), at most 50 | Allow patterns to remove. |
| `secrets.test_secrets` | object | Whether access fields may hold harmless test values marked {"value": "...", "test": true}. There is no live key: never on live. |
| `secrets.test_secrets.local` | boolean | Allowed on local environments. |
| `secrets.test_secrets.test` | boolean | Allowed on test environments. |
| `secrets.expose_test_secrets_to_agents` | boolean | Show test secret values to agents in environments_get (otherwise only their names). |

A custom pattern (`guard.patterns`, `guard.patterns+`):

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Stable id, not one of the built-in rule ids. |
| `capability` | one of `sign_in`, `ssh`, `kubectl`, `db`, `deploy`, `null` | Capability whose level applies; null or absent: any identifier. |
| `command` | string (at most 200 characters) | Optional: the command the change must follow in the same command segment. |
| `change` | string (at most 200 characters) | What makes the call a change (case-insensitive). |
| `description` | string (at most 200 characters) | Shown in the guard's reason, after "this looks like a". |

## Built-in guard rules

| Id | Capability | Reason says |
|---|---|---|
| `kubectl-change` | `kubectl` | kubectl change |
| `helm-change` | `deploy` | helm change |
| `ssh-remote-change` | `ssh` | remote change over ssh |
| `scp-to-host` | `ssh` | file copy to a host |
| `sftp-session` | `ssh` | file transfer session |
| `sql-change` | `db` | SQL change |
| `git-push` | `deploy` | git push |
| `terraform-change` | `deploy` | terraform change |
| `mcp-tool-name` | any | MCP tool whose name says it changes something |

## Built-in secret detectors

`private-key`, `github-token`, `github-pat`, `gitlab-token`, `openai-key`, `aws-access-key`, `slack-token`, `jwt`, `url-credentials`, `password-flag`, `curl-user`, `auth-header`, `token-header`, `sshpass`, `mysql-password`, `docker-login-password`, `redis-password`, `secret-assignment`, `secret-field-name`, `user-password`.

Switching a detector off affects only the check on write; the live-actions journal
still masks every shape it knows.

## Presets

### `default`

relaybay's behaviour without a policy file.

```json
{
  "description": "relaybay's behaviour without a policy file.",
  "levels": {
    "local": {
      "default": "full"
    },
    "test": {
      "default": "full"
    },
    "live": {
      "default": "read"
    }
  },
  "guard": {
    "mode": "warn",
    "disable": [],
    "patterns": []
  },
  "approvals": {
    "commit": false,
    "push": true,
    "merge": true,
    "test": true,
    "live": true,
    "desktop": false,
    "disable": [],
    "ignore": []
  },
  "secrets": {
    "disable": [],
    "allow": [],
    "test_secrets": {
      "local": false,
      "test": false
    },
    "expose_test_secrets_to_agents": false
  }
}
```

### `strict`

Agents ask on test and stay off live; the guard blocks.

```json
{
  "description": "Agents ask on test and stay off live; the guard blocks.",
  "levels": {
    "local": {
      "default": "full"
    },
    "test": {
      "default": "ask"
    },
    "live": {
      "default": "none"
    }
  },
  "guard": {
    "mode": "block",
    "disable": [],
    "patterns": []
  },
  "approvals": {
    "commit": false,
    "push": true,
    "merge": true,
    "test": true,
    "live": true,
    "desktop": false,
    "disable": [],
    "ignore": []
  },
  "secrets": {
    "disable": [],
    "allow": [],
    "test_secrets": {
      "local": false,
      "test": false
    },
    "expose_test_secrets_to_agents": false
  }
}
```

### `trusted`

A trusted machine: full access everywhere, the guard only journals, test secrets on local and test.

```json
{
  "description": "A trusted machine: full access everywhere, the guard only journals, test secrets on local and test.",
  "levels": {
    "local": {
      "default": "full"
    },
    "test": {
      "default": "full"
    },
    "live": {
      "default": "full"
    }
  },
  "guard": {
    "mode": "log",
    "disable": [],
    "patterns": []
  },
  "approvals": {
    "commit": false,
    "push": true,
    "merge": true,
    "test": true,
    "live": true,
    "desktop": false,
    "disable": [],
    "ignore": []
  },
  "secrets": {
    "disable": [],
    "allow": [],
    "test_secrets": {
      "local": true,
      "test": true
    },
    "expose_test_secrets_to_agents": false
  }
}
```
